name: feature-ladder
description: Orchestration ladder for adding features, atomically and without waiting: a Sonnet intake scout settles every routing variable and asks once, a Hindsight-backed confidence surface sizes each Task Card (>= 0.60 proceeds, below that the card is resharded), one cheap worker (GLM 5.3 Flash through OpenRouter, or Sonnet medium) implements the change and its tests on its own branch, a script checks it, and every entry of the PR stack is merged into the original base branch and labelled review: pending. Outside-repo steps run and are logged, never gated (the only denial is printing a secret value). Fable only integrates when two or more coding agents wrote code; Codex review, second opinions and memory run once per session at /feature-ladder:wrap. Deterministic model routing and skill selection, per-repository Hindsight memory behind a strict gate, and checked-in evidence (golden corpora, SBOM, SARIF) that pins every script. Requires an OpenRouter key for the GLM tier.
